categories.purpose: Own categories feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the discovery context.
categories.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

items.purpose: Own items feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the discovery context.
items.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

shell-support.purpose: Provide reusable shell-support assets shared by multiple discovery slices.
shell-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
shell-support.justification: shell-support centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
shell-support.createdFor: Multi-slice workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
shell-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.

routes.purpose: Expose context-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
